name: TTF-Q response-blind qualification of dyadic ecological predictors
purpose: Characterize when a source-target ecological relation is stably measured, non-redundant with known structure, distributed across enough dyadic support, and capable of supporting intended inference before any biological response is opened.

outputs.relation_repeatability: Balanced one-way random-effects ICC across fixed dyads from response-blind resampling replicates of the relation; reported as a continuous measurement-stability diagnostic.
outputs.nonredundancy: Fraction of focal-relation variance remaining after exact two-way source/target fixed-effect absorption and projection on the intended nuisance controls.
outputs.dyadic_signal_support: Inverse-Herfindahl effective counts of squared residual focal-relation signal across dyads, source endpoints, and target endpoints; these are concentration diagnostics, not independent sample-size estimates.
outputs.detectability_surface: Two-way-cluster-robust synthetic rejection rates over a frozen effect-size by private-heterogeneity grid, with Wilson intervals.
outputs.evaluable_envelope: The continuous joint description above. No pass/fail status is assigned to the ecological predictor.

B_environmental_niche_similarity.legacy_reason: technical external-occurrence transport failure before relation qualification and before genetic-response opening

C_historical_climate_displacement_simila.legacy_reason: bounded occurrence transport retained unresolved REQUEST_ERROR species after the single frozen retry; no genetic response opened
C_historical_climate_displacement_simila.scientific_nonredundancy_question: How much historical-climate similarity remains after current-climate similarity, geography, lineage, locality imbalance, and source/target identity are removed?

detectability_surface.inheritance_note: The synthetic world scale and nuisance structure are inherited from the prospectively frozen B/C qualification rules only to characterize the same intended inferential task. TTF-Q replaces their binary gate with a surface; it does not alter or revive either legacy slot.

interpretation_policy.minimum_detectable_effect_rule: smallest positive standardized effect whose Wilson 95% lower bound on rejection probability is at least target_power, separately for each private-heterogeneity amplitude
